summary: Test parses a spec whose heading is '### codex-session-scrollback.1: Retention' inside specs/codex-session-scrollback.md and asserts a violation with rule REQ-011.2.4 specifically; scratch mutations that (a) route the own-stem case to the generic REQ-011.2.3 rule and (b) silently accept the stem-qualified heading as a valid section both fail this test, and sibling assertions that a well-formed bare spec has zero violations rule out an over-broad rule.
